messages.subject: Re: oSCR sex ratio??
messages.body_plain:
Hi Rachel,

In oSCR, you will get an estimate of the probability that an individual selected at random is a male, *on the link scale*, so in effect is the proportion of the population that is male. The formula you cite is a standard one and will give you the sex ration, as long as you back-transform the estimate to the probability scale.

Hope that helps.

Chris
